description: Cost Plus Drugs mail-order cash prices from its official pricing API: search by drug name (optionally strength) or NDC; returns medication and brand name, generic/brand, form, strength, treatment categories, pack size, RxNorm ID, in-stock flag, price per unit (USD, incl. markup), cash dispensing fee, 30/60/90-count pack prices with and without fee, total with shipping, and product URL. Only drugs sold on the CPD mail-order channel. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ndc.description: National Drug Code, with or without dashes, e.g. 67877-0511-10 (matches generic equivalents)

term.description: Drug or brand name, partial match, e.g. atorvastatin or Lipitor (term or ndc required)
